errors.evidence: The description identifies the label for the tallest bar as “路段” (road section), but the actual label in the chart is “路” (road).
The description states the frequency of the tallest bar is approximately 150, but the bar is clearly below the 150 line, at a value closer to 145.
The description identifies the label for the shortest bar as “以余”, but the actual label on the chart is “食物” (food). The term “以余” does not appear on the chart.
The description states the frequency for the shortest bar is approximately 10, but its value is visibly higher, around 25.
